en:
Ohhhh! Heroes shouldn't be asleep on the job!
It's pathetic!
Whaaa—!?

Good morning! Although it's technically still
night, do you feel well rested anyway?
M-Monokuma!?

Nice face, Shuichi. You definitely look your
best in the morning.

You could look better, though. I'm pretty picky
about people's morning faces.
...What are you doing here?
How rude! My time is very valuable, you know!

Since you fell asleep still clutching the Love
Key...

I went out of my way to come wake you!
I really wish you were more appreciative!

Love Key...? You mean this thing
I won at the casino?
Yep, yep! I'll tell you how to use it.
How to "use" it?

Puhuhu... That key opens the way to a very
special place...

A place you might've seen in the vicinity
of the casino... Hint hint...

<CLT=cltMIND>Oh, right. *That* building.
I suppose it would have this kind of key...
Puhuhu! You look like you've figured it out!

Good. A healthy teenager's brain is supposed
to be obsessed with <CLT=cltSTRONG>sex<CLT=cltNORMAL> and <CLT=cltSTRONG>lust<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

That key you got there should help you
clear out some of those carnal desires!
...Huh?

Oh, are you starting to get worked up?
Are you ready to let it all hang out?
Now then, please read the instructions.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>It's time for The Talk.
The Love Key Talk.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>This is a key that is used to
unlock the Love Suite.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>When night falls, you and one other
person will be invited to the Love Suite.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>There, you will be part of
<CLT=cltSTRONG>that person's fantasy<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>They will see you as their "ideal,"
and basically just swoon all over you.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Think of it as a kind of dream that lets
you escape this cruel, dark reality.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>That's why it's so important to play
the role that person wants you to.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>If you do something that breaks character,
the other person will wake up in anguish.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>And what happens there, stays there.
Memories are wiped when you exit.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>It's like a one-night-stand within a dream.
Probably best that you both forget it.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Well then, that's it!
Stay safe! Enjoy!

Oh? You seem skeptical. Why don't you
try it out for yourself, then?
Go ahead, take that Love Key out for a spin...

Now then, let love take hold of you! It'll make
you sweeter than a bear's honey pot!

<CLT=cltMIND>I watched Monokuma bounce away,
stunned. The key felt heavy in my hand.

Well...
I suppose...it couldn't hurt...
